editorial_notes: Written about the PREVIOUS edition, from published reporting on it, to help a reader decide on the next one. No rating: the sources are news reports and organiser statements, which describe how an event was run, not how runners rated it. A score needs participant evidence -- race reports, runner blogs, attributed quotes -- and without it would be invention.
title: Industropolis Run 2026 Review: What the 2025 Edition Was Like
seo_title: Industropolis Run 2026 Review | Batang, Central Java
meta_description: Industropolis Run review: 2,525 runners in 2025, a new half marathon and an AIMS-certified course in Batang's industrial estate. What to expect in 2026.
dek: A race inside an industrial estate that has quietly become a certified international course. It added a half marathon only in 2025, grew by a quarter in a year, and is now AIMS certified. Here is what last year was like.
verdict: Industropolis Run is a young event on the way up. The 2025 edition on Sunday 7 December at KEK Industropolis Batang drew 2,525 runners, up from 2,000 the year before [1], and it was the first year with a half marathon -- 2024 offered only 5 km and 10 km [2]. The course is now AIMS certified [1], which means an internationally recognised measurement, and the event collected donations for disaster victims in Sumatra [1]. An industrial estate is an unusual place for a race, but it gives you wide, closed, quiet roads at dawn.

sections.heading: The 2025 Edition
paragraphs: The 2025 race was held on Sunday 7 December inside KEK Industropolis Batang, the special economic zone in Batang regency on Central Java's north coast [1]. It drew 2,525 participants across 5 km, 10 km and the half marathon [1].
That was a jump of around a quarter on the previous year, when the event drew about 2,000 [1] -- a meaningful rise for a race still establishing itself.

sections.heading: A Half Marathon That Is Brand New
paragraphs: The most important thing to understand about this race's half marathon is how recent it is. The 2024 edition offered only 5 km and 10 km; the half marathon was added for 2025 [2].

That cuts both ways. A new distance often comes with teething problems in its first years. It also means a smaller, less crowded half marathon field than the event's total size suggests, since most of the 2,525 runners were in the shorter races.

sections.heading: An AIMS-Certified Course
paragraphs: The course is now certified by AIMS, the international association of road race organisers [1]. Batang's regent put it plainly: the certification means the course is recognised internationally [1].
For a runner, certification is the difference between a time that counts and one that does not. A certified half marathon course is measured to a standard, so a personal best set here is a real one.

sections.heading: What to Expect in 2026
paragraphs: The 2026 edition is scheduled for Sunday 6 December, starting at 4.00am WIB at Kawasan Industri Terpadu Batang in Gringsing, again over 5 km, 10 km and the half marathon [3].

The organisers have published generous cut-offs: 90 minutes for the 5 km, 150 minutes for the 10 km and 210 minutes for the half [3]. A 3 hour 30 minute half marathon cut-off is forgiving by regional standards and makes this a sensible first attempt at the distance.

sections.heading: Should You Enter?
paragraphs: Yes, especially for a first half marathon or a certified time without the crowds of a big-city race. The combination of a new, uncrowded half, an internationally certified course and a forgiving cut-off is unusual.
The trade-off is setting. Running through an industrial estate is not scenic, and Batang is some way from the region's main cities. Come for the course and the certification, not the view.
This review is compiled from published reporting on the previous edition and the organisers' own announcements. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.

faqs.question: Is the Industropolis Run course certified?
faqs.answer: Yes. The course is certified by AIMS, the international association of road race organisers, which means it is measured to an internationally recognised standard. A time set on it, including a half marathon personal best, therefore counts.

faqs.question: How many people ran Industropolis Run in 2025?
faqs.answer: 2,525 runners took part on Sunday 7 December 2025 inside KEK Industropolis Batang, up from about 2,000 the year before. 2025 was also the first year the event offered a half marathon; the 2024 edition had only 5 km and 10 km.

faqs.question: Is Industropolis Run a good first half marathon?
faqs.answer: It is a sensible choice. The half marathon field is small because the distance is new, the course is AIMS certified, and the organisers publish a forgiving 210-minute cut-off. The setting, an industrial estate, is not scenic, but the roads are wide and closed.
